source_segment: You've been dreaming of a mathmatical formula that has been driving you slowly mad...and the only solution is to unscramble the numbers until the formulas speak to you.
machine_translation: 数式を解くと、数式が話しかけてくるのです。

source_segment: You'll need a ^orange;Growing Tray^reset; to do anything with your fertilizer - if you're just growing plants out of the ground with a hoe and watering can, it won't be of any use to you.
machine_translation: 肥料で何でもやるには、^orange;Growing Tray^reset;が必要です。

source_segment: Over the course of several centuries they guided our species from savagery to civilization, and we were more than willing to do whatever they asked as thanks for their gifts.
machine_translation: 何世紀もの間、彼らは私たちの種を汚職から文明へと導いてくれた。

source_segment: I don't think J-11 is traceable back to us in any way, so it's just a write-off - I'll just let those protectorate do-gooders take care of the problem once the inevitable starts.
machine_translation: 私は、J-11は、いかなる方法でも、トレース可能であるとは思いません。

source_segment: Well, while we did honestly help defend them, they could've easily kept their numbers as high as they are anyways; we were preventing them from exploding in numbers before the Florans came in and started doing so; we're just preventing the plants from being too aggressive in the population control.
machine_translation: フロランがやって来る前に、彼らは数を爆発させないようにしていた。我々は単に植物が人口管理に積極的すぎることを防ぐためだ。

source_segment: Some among the Skath believe the Seekers have one more sacred duty: To seek out and locate the race that attempted to wipe them out not so long ago and bring the vengeance of the Skath against them.
machine_translation: スカース族の中には、シーカーたちにはもう一つの神聖な義務があると考える人もいます。

source_segment: You've learned how to develop some specialized plants that enhance your mobility in water, and created Vorit, a strange jelly-like mushroom which allows you to breathe normally underwater or even in a total vacuum for a while, then harmlessly passes through your system.
machine_translation: 水の中での移動性を高めるための特殊な植物の開発方法を学んだら、奇妙なゼリー状のキノコ「Vorit」が作られました。

source_segment: The device itself was found while scavenging through a nearly intact X'ian city (if you can call this place a city...I am not sure how best to name it) composed of strange looping patterns of graphite and cobalt merged together to form myriad structures that towered above like skyscrapers but composed of octogonal 'units' that could very well have been individual apartments.
machine_translation: グラファイトとコバルトの奇妙なループパターンが組み合わさって、高層ビルのようにそびえ立つ無数の構造を形成していますが、それは八角形の「ユニット」でできています。

source_segment: Soon, it may be possible to replace up to 70% of bananas consumed by all Apex with 'I can't believe it's not banana!' coralcreep-derived paste, lowering costs and easing rationing procedures.
machine_translation: 間もなく、すべてのApexが消費するバナナの70%を「バナナではないとは思えない!

source_segment: Their body chemistry resembles nothing we've seen in our galaxy thus far, with very little affecting their cells - specialized diseases seem one of the few things that affect them.
machine_translation: 彼らの身体の化学反応は、これまで銀河系で目にしたことの無いものに似たものです。

source_segment: In the end I must rely on the judgment and standing of the few scientific leaders who have, on the one hand, sufficient independence of thought to weigh my data on its own hideously convincing merits or in the light of certain primordial and highly baffling myth-cycles; and on the other hand, sufficient influence to deter the exploring world in general from any rash and overambitious programme in the region of those mountains of madness.
machine_translation: 結局のところ、私は、自分のデータを、自身の不快に説得力のあるメリットや、特定の原始的で非常に困惑的な神話のサイクルの光に照らして、十分な独立性を持つ、少数の科学指導者の判断と地位に頼らざるを得ません。

source_segment: Nobody understands particles quite like you do, and you've got a way to prove it: By combining particles with biomass to form entirely new constructs that violate the ordinary laws of existence!
machine_translation: 粒子とバイオマスを組み合わせることで、普通の存在法則に違反する全く新しい構造を形成します。

source_segment: Equipped only with the contents of your herb pouch, you're now equipped to explore nearly any world imaginable, including those with lead-melting heat, atmospheres so cold it falls to the ground as snow and environments so radioactive that even the ground glistens with energy.
machine_translation: ハーブポーチの中身だけを装備し、鉛溶融熱を持つもの、雪のように地面に落ちるような寒い雰囲気、そして地面でさえエネルギーで輝きます。

source_segment: Do Not create any sort of infinite back-and-forth loop that shifts the same items between the same containers unless you have a very good reason to do so. This can be a substantial source of lag.
machine_translation: 同じコンテナ間で同じアイテムを移動させる無限の前後ループのようなものを作成しないでください。

source_segment: The most powerful generator in the game bar none, Precursor Reactors create phenomenal amounts of power but cannot be crafted, and are instead found in the abandoned colonies and factories of the extinct Precursors.
machine_translation: ゲームバーで最も強力な発電機は、前駆反応器は驚異的な量の力を作り出しますが、作成することはできません。

source_segment: But my shuttle is too damaged for anything but the laziest of evasions, I pray aloud that my ship won't be struck; the ablative plating already having been crumpled into a very expensive ball.
machine_translation: でも、シャトルが破損しすぎて、一番遅延した避難船以外は、船がぶつからないように祈っています。

source_segment: I have lived in the deserts and the wastelands, and spoken with demons and the souls of slaughtered men, and of women who have died in childbirth, victims of the she-fiend LAMMASHTA.
machine_translation: 私は砂漠や荒野に住んでおり、悪魔や虐殺された男性の魂、出産で死んだ女性の魂と話しました。

source_segment: of men are seen and surveyed by that Ancient Race of gods and demons from a time before time, and that they seek revenge for that forgotten battle that took place somewhere in the Cosmos and rent the Worlds in the days before the creation of Man, when the Elder Gods walked the Spaces, the race of MARDUK, as he is known to the Chaldeans, and of ENKI our master, the Lord of Magicians.
machine_translation: 人類の長老の神々は、彼がシャルドアンに知られているように、宇宙、マルドゥクの人種を歩いたとき、彼らは、宇宙のどこかで起こったその忘れられた戦いの復見を求め、人類の創造の前に世界を借りる。

source_segment: Covering nearly all of the structures was a thin layer of an ash-like substance that gave everything the appearance of having been burned in a great conflagration in the ancient past.
machine_translation: ほとんど全ての構造物を覆うのは灰のような物質の薄い層で、古代の大火で焼かれたように見える。

source_segment: Investing into this tree will allow you to learn to create your own plant seeds to grow foodstuffs or useful effect-granting plants, how to raise farm beasts, how to hunt and fish, advanced farming techniques and how to raise bees.
machine_translation: この木に投資すると、食べ物や有用な効果を与える植物を育てるための独自の植物種子を作成することを学ぶことができます。

source_segment: I think I'm going to start digging down into the ground, maybe board the exit off behind me. I don't want to get pulled into the jungle by some nasty beast or something.
machine_translation: 地面に潜り込み後ろの出口に乗っかってジャングルの中へいやな獣に引っ張られたくないんだ

source_segment: It is the only such form of government known in the cosmos (for how can only four dictate the course of an entire species?) but has maintained power over the Skath Imperium for at least two to three hundred years.
machine_translation: 宇宙で知られている唯一の政府形態であるが、少なくとも二年から三〇〇年間、スカース帝国の支配権を握っている。

source_segment: Durasteel is known to be tailor-made for use in a vacuum because of its amazing ability to smooth dents and cuts, assuming anything is strong enough to scratch it.
machine_translation: Durasteelは、真空中での使用用にカスタムメイドされることが知られています。

source_segment: We are, on the other hand, the most capable undersea species there is and our own architectural style had an advantage: it was already designed for high pressure.
machine_translation: 一方、私たちは最も有能な水中生物種であり、独自の建築スタイルには利点がありました。

source_segment: You've also dipped into stranger, less corporeal realms, and created a type of plant which can be eaten in a life-or-death situation to pull you away to safety.
machine_translation: 身近な人や肉体的な領域に足を踏み入れ、生死を問わず食べられる植物を作り出しました。

source_segment: You've learned how to best apply cotton and plastic polymers in the creation of comfortable and useful armor that will be quite helpful when you're in atmosphere.
machine_translation: 快適で有用な装甲の開発に綿とプラスチックポリマーを最もよく適用する方法を学びました。

source_segment: Atheist Avians who require punishment are dipped in a vat of tar-like liquid, which solidifies over their feathers, turning their plumage into what is essentially stone.
machine_translation: 無神論者のアヴィア人は、罰を必要とし、その羽を固め、羽を石に変え、タール状の液体に浸す。

source_segment: Oh, and side effects may include: dry mouth, nausea, vomiting, water retention, tingling rectal itch, hallucination, epiphany, psychosis, coma, death, and a fate worse than death.
machine_translation: 口臭、吐き気、吐出、保水、直腸かゆみ、幻覚、エピファニー、精神病、コマ、死、死よりも悪い運命。

source_segment: It is altogether against my will that I tell my reasons for opposing this contemplated invasion of the antarctic with its vast fossil-hunt and its wholesale boring and melting of the ancient ice-cap—and I am the more reluctant because my warning may be in vain.
machine_translation: 広大な化石狩りと、古代の氷冠の卸売りの退屈と融解で、南極にこの熟考された侵略に反対する私の理由を話すことは、私の意志に完全に反しています。

source_segment: It appears to be exceptionally absorbent, allowing the majority of a X'is radioaction to not spill out from its body and instead be reabsorbed and used to further fuel the core.
machine_translation: 吸収性が非常に高く、Xの放射能の大半は体からこぼれ出さず、吸収されて核をさらに燃料に利用する。

source_segment: We know not why, nor how, but we were attempting to escape a raiding party of Volarian monsters and out of nowhere a squad of Underdwellers came from beneath the waves.
machine_translation: 私たちは理由も方法も知らないが、我々はヴォラリアンモンスターの襲撃隊を逃れようとしていた。

source_segment: I suggest we find a way to encourage a war between these two species in order to reduce their surplus populations, lest we all suffer the consequences of unchecked growth.
machine_translation: 私は、これらの二つの種間の戦争を奨励して、余剰人口を減らす方法を見つけることをお勧めします。

source_segment: This tome details the importance of swords among the Nightar people, circa their Classical era (dated to approximately 2,300 years ago) up to their Imperial era (1,223 years).

source_segment: The name is disputed, though Kenvik Raeis (noted scholar of some repute, having literally written the book on inter-species relations in the Protectorate) believes its name translates to 'Xuveh'.

source_segment: Densely colonized by trees and other flora, this ^#15ce02;forest ^reset;landing site is a hospitable location that supports a diversity of life - potentially including your own.

source_segment: You've created a number of even stronger plants, which are devastating when thrown, and in the case of hellfire plants can even be used to create some powerful weapons, with some further research in the weaponry tree.
machine_translation: 投げられたときに壊滅的な被害を被る強力な植物をいくつも作りました。地獄の火の植物の場合は、強力な武器を作成するためにも使用できます。

source_segment: Sorry we can't let you use most of the crafting and processing machines - We had to restrict access after Kevin tried to use them to create a gun that shot smaller versions of itself.
machine_translation: ケビンがそれを使って、より小さなバージョンを撃ち落とす銃を作った後、アクセスを制限しなければならなかったのです。

source_segment: Using your knowledge of atmospheric mechanics, you've designed a device which filters the air and regulates temperature, providing protection against many hazards while nearby.
machine_translation: 大気力学の知識を使って、空気を濾過し、温度を調節し、近くにいる間、多くの危険から保護する装置を設計しました。

source_segment: - The spores emitted from an Agaran are able to track sources of warm moisture (especially blood) from several kilometers away and use wind to reach their target.
machine_translation: -アガランから放出される胞子によって、数キロ先から温水(特に血液)を追跡し、風を使って目標に達する。

source_segment: Over the course of only a few thousand years, they begin to exhibit unusual capabilities that have thus far not been replicated by any known creatures in the galaxy.
machine_translation: わずか数千年の間に、彼らはこれまで銀河内の既知の生物によって複製されていない珍しい能力を示し始めます。

source_segment: The Kirhos do not see any reason they can't bargain with the universe itself, and are slowly accumulating their wealth toward the time when they can trade their smaller coins for one that will take them to this new goal.
machine_translation: カーロは宇宙そのものと交渉できない理由を何も見ていないし、小さな硬貨を新しい目標に向かって取引できる時代に向けて徐々に富を蓄積している。

source_segment: A challenger must first prove their might in a test decided by the 10 Vat'iish council members, and should they survive, the leader will allow the trial to take place.
machine_translation: 挑戦者はまず、10Vat'iish評議会のメンバーによって決定されたテストで力を証明する必要があります。

source_segment: It immediately begins consuming the hosts brain from the inside out, absorbing memory and motor function, and quite possibly everything else that made the host a unique individual.
